description: Public reproducer of host signature verification disagreement. The signature is valid by independent affine P-256 arithmetic, Python cryptography/OpenSSL4, and Homebrew OpenSSL3. Apple CryptoKit, Security, and system LibreSSL3.3.6 reject it. No production verifier relaxation.
testedProviders: Apple CryptoKit P256 message and explicit SHA256 digest overloads
independent Python affine P-256 ECDSA arithmetic: accepts
scope: Observed for intentionally tiny scalar9 test key. Replacement full-width deterministic and randomly generated keys each passed2048 roundtrips. Production verification fails closed. This artifact does not establish which other public keys or providers are affected, or the underlying cause.
